<!-- Shared body of each comparison page. Each page sets `branch` and `type`
     and includes this file. -->

```{r}
#| include: false
# Use the package source in this checkout if possible, so changes to R/ show
# up without reinstalling
if (file.exists("../../DESCRIPTION") && requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
    pkgload::load_all("../..", quiet = TRUE)
} else {
    library(biocUniTools)
}
config <- yaml::read_yaml("../config.yml")
data_file <- file.path("..", config$data_dir,
                       sprintf("compare-%s-%s.rds", branch, type))
has_data <- file.exists(data_file)
old_data <- FALSE
if (has_data) {
    cmp <- readRDS(data_file)
    # Data saved by an older biocUniTools may lack columns this page uses
    old_data <- !all(c("uni_source_build", "uni_check_diverged") %in% names(cmp))
    has_data <- !old_data
}
compared <- if (type == "workflows")
    "BBS `R CMD build` and R Universe source `R CMD build`" else
    "BBS `R CMD check` and R Universe `R CMD check`"
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (old_data) {
    cat("The saved data is from an older version of biocUniTools. Run",
        "`pkgload::load_all(); write_comparisons(\"reports/config.yml\")`",
        "from the repository to update it.\n")
} else if (!has_data) {
    cat("No data yet. Run `biocUniTools::write_comparisons(\"reports/config.yml\")`.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) compare_header(cmp)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) compare_bars(cmp)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) compare_details(cmp)
```

<details>
<summary>Legend</summary>

- **Same result**: `r compared` (the shaded columns) agree. NOTE is treated
  as OK; WARNING(S) are treated the same.
- **Status**: R Universe's overall result for the package: success or failure.
- **Source build**: R Universe `R CMD build` of the source package, which
  builds vignettes.
- **Binary check**: `R CMD check` associated with the binary.

</details>
